<!-- pr-reviewer: e16d668f1cd6903e25b5846b57df5120523390f4 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (the machine codes are not sourced, so the post would write guessed words; the code itself builds and passes)

Thanks @JSwetz, this is a solid start and the structure follows our engine cleanly.

**What looks good**
- Clean-room: the script is built on our own `fanuc.cps` hook contract (`block`, `onRapid`, `onLinear`, `onProbeMove`, ...). I found no Autodesk post-API idioms (`writeBlock`, `createFormat`, `createVariable`), and no vendor text. There is a provenance header.
- Trial merge with current `upstream/main` is clean (no conflicts).
- `docs/decisions/614-doosan-dnm-post.md` is present, and the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #614`.
- No dependency, `build.rs`, `.github/` or scripts changes.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test doosan_dnm_post` | 6 passed |
| `--test conformance` | 6 passed |
| `--test golden_cl` | 23 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. **Unsourced M codes** (`assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:1-9`, `:92-98`, `:231-235`, `:373-376`, `:584`). TSC `M88/M89`, rotary `M11`/`M10`, conveyor `M31`/`M33` are cited to "published Doosan manuals" with no document, edition or page, and the PR has no machine sample, which is what #614 asked for. These codes differ per builder and option set. Please either attach the sample or cite the exact manual pages. Until then, refuse by name (e.g. "TSC code not declared for this machine") instead of defaulting. Concretely, `coolantFor` falls back to `M88` when the machine lacks a through-tool entry, and `M31`/`M33`/`M10`/`M11` are hard-coded. Take these codes from the machine file or a post option, and refuse when missing.
2. **Smoothing without a stated bound** (`doosan-dnm.cps:103-127`, `:382-383`). `G05.1 Q1`/`Q0` is written with no parameter range, and the issue asked for the line "with its R range". Per #616/#635, smoothing is designed as per-op smoothing and Fanuc currently names the ask and writes no unbounded G5.1. Either state and enforce the bound from a cited source, or refuse and wait for #635. Note also `G05.1 Q1` is the AI contour control form on a 0i/31i; please cite which control option it needs. Reading `postOptions.smoothing` / `properties.smoothing` is a private knob that bypasses the #616 design.
3. **Rotary clamp** (`doosan-dnm.cps:132-150`). `M10` is appended in the same block as the `A` word on a rapid (`rotWords.push("M10")`), so clamp may execute with the motion rather than after it, and the `machine.mch` declares `"table": {"rotation": "none"}` while the post emits A moves. Emit the clamp as its own block after the move, and declare the rotary in the machine file with sources. The post also never clamps/unclamps for non-rapid A moves before a cutting section other than at section end; please pin that.
4. **Manifest claims** (`doosan-dnm.cps:19-20`). `axisInversion = true` and `probeAxisInversion = true` were copied from `fanuc.cps`. The probing path was rewritten (Inspection Plus `G65 P9810/P9811`), and no inverted-stream test exists for it. Remove the flags or add the equivalence tests. Inspection Plus macro numbers/arguments also need a source (Renishaw's public docs) or a refusal.
5. **Machine file** (`assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch`). Travels, 12000 rpm, rapids 36/36/30 m/min and coolant codes have no cited spec sheet. It also has no tool-magazine/ATC or rigid-tap data and is not registered in `posting::MACHINES`, so the picker cannot reach it. Cite the DN Solutions spec, and register it.
6. **Tests**: they pin the guessed output, not a source. Once 1-3 change, add refusal-by-name tests (TSC undeclared, rotary lock undeclared, probing style unknown, smoothing unbounded).
7. Process nit: the PR adds 593 lines in one `.cps` (post scripts are exempt from the 400-line rule).

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Registry conflicts for the maintainer: this PR appends to `posting::BUILTINS` / `conformance.rs` `POSTS`+`EXTENSIONS`; open PRs #624, #627, #634, #654 also touch the `posting` registry lists and machine expectations, so expect merge churn when they land in sequence.
- Golden diffs are all new files (nothing existing changed). Snapshot pixel diffs are not involved.
- @spikeypineapple offered a DNM sample on #614; a short program with the TSC, clamp, conveyor and probing lines would settle items 1-4 directly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2e8817e88b33abd9c7f40ab94e46b7cb35970bdf -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one test fails, caused by this PR; the rest of the earlier findings are largely addressed)

Thanks @JSwetz, the rework is a big step forward: G5.1 is now bounded and cancelled before drilling cycles, the clamp is on its own block, and the refusals are named and tested.

**Prior findings (review at e16d668)**
| # | finding | now |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | unsourced M codes, silent defaults | Partly. TSC refuses by name when the machine has no through-tool coolant (tested). Rotary refuses by name when no clamp codes are declared (tested). Cited only to "Doosan DNM Instruction / Operation Manual Table 4-1" with no document number, edition or page; M31/M33 are still hard-coded (`doosan-dnm.cps:458`, `:720`) and the sample program the PR text mentions is not attached |
| 2 | smoothing unbounded | Fixed: R1..R10 enforced, integer only, refused by name (`:177-190`), Fanuc option cited |
| 3 | M10 in the motion block | Fixed: M11 / move / M10 on separate blocks (`:523-531`), pinned by test |
| 4 | axisInversion flags | Fixed: removed |
| 5 | machine file | Not fixed: `doosan-dnm.mch` is still not in `posting::MACHINES` (see 1 below), and still declares `"table": {"rotation": "none"}` with no rotary clamp codes |
| 6 | refusal tests | Fixed: 4 refusals pinned in `doosan_dnm_refuses_undeclared_codes_by_name` |

**What looks good**
- Clean-room: the script uses our own fanuc-style hook contract; no Autodesk post-API idioms and no vendor text found. Provenance header present, decision record present, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #614` present.
- No `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts, process-file or dependency changes. No snapshot PNGs. Goldens are all new files (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/doosan-dnm/*`, `synth_doosan-dnm.nc`).
- Branch merges cleanly with current main (trial merge: already up to date), so the `conflicts` label no longer applies.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `--test doosan_dnm_post` | 7 passed |
| `--test conformance` (byte-exact on all goldens) | 6 passed |
| `--test posting` / `--test fanuc_post` / `--test inverted_post` | 11 / 15 passed (inverted_post run in the same group, no failures) |
| `--test machine_library` | **1 failed**, 10 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

```
thread 'every_machine_file_in_assets_is_in_the_library' panicked at crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs:120:9:
.../assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch is not registered in posting::MACHINES
```

**Requested before merge**
1. Register the machine: add `("Doosan DNM 5700", include_str!("../../../assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch"))` to `posting::MACHINES` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, near the other machines). This fixes the failing test and makes the machine reachable from the picker.
2. Make the shipped machine post its own 4th axis: it has an A rotary but declares no clamp/unclamp codes, so an A move on it is refused unless the user sets post options. Either declare M10/M11 in the machine file (as the coolants are) or say in the decision record that rotary is opt-in, and set `"table"` consistently with the rotary.
3. Take M31/M33 (`doosan-dnm.cps:458`, `:720`) from the machine file or a post option, like the clamp codes, and refuse by name when the ask is made without them. These codes are builder/option specific.
4. Sources: give the Doosan manual's document number and edition and the page for Table 4-1, or attach the sample program (the PR text and decision record cite "the real sample program from PR #665" but nothing is attached). The owner also asked for G-code evidence on the PR; the goldens are generated by the post itself so they pin behavior, not the source.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Refusals go through `msg()`, a counted warning like the Fanuc post; I did not find a path that emits an unbounded G5.1 or an A move without clamp codes.
- The `.cps` is 729 lines; post scripts are exempt from the 400-line rule.
- On your question about the manuals: citing them as behaviour references is fine; do not copy their text, and do not commit the PDFs to the repo.
- Cosmetic: the test-status text in the PR body lists conformance as covering "13 goldens"; fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 858c613b634504668b0b39668983250a7eca3f68 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - three of the four earlier requests are addressed; the manual evidence (4) is still missing, and (2) is only half done.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Re-review at head 858c613b, tested merged with current main (clean, no conflicts; mergeable).

### Earlier requests
1. **Register in `posting::MACHINES`: done.** `crates/app/src/posting.rs` lists "Doosan DNM 5700" and `machine.rs` pins it; `every_machine_file_in_assets_is_in_the_library` passes.
2. **M10/M11 and rotation: partly done.** The `.mch` now declares the A rotary on [1,0,0], which is consistent. But M10/M11 are still not declared by the machine file: `getRotaryCodes()` (`assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:109-139`) falls back to matching the machine *name* for "doosan"/"dnm" and then assumes M10/M11. That is a guess keyed on a string, so any machine a user names "DNM ..." with an A axis gets M10/M11 whether or not its builder wired them. Please either require the codes via `rotaryClamp`/`rotaryUnclamp` (or `rotaryBrake`) options only and refuse by name otherwise, or put them in the machine definition if the machine schema can carry them. If the name match stays, say plainly in the decision record that rotary brake is assumed for DNM-named machines.
3. **M31/M33: done.** No hardcoded default remains; codes come from post options/properties/machine and the post refuses by name ("chip conveyor codes not declared ...", `doosan-dnm.cps:489-498`), pinned by `doosan_dnm_refuses_undeclared_codes_by_name`. (Note: the `.mch` schema has no chip-conveyor field, so in practice this is options-only; fine.)
4. **Manual evidence: not done.** The citations are still "Doosan DNM Instruction / Operation Manual Table 4-1 (pp. 4-1 to 4-5)": no document number, edition or revision, and no attached sample program. The PR text and decision record say the post is aligned with a "real Doosan DNM sample program", but none is attached to the PR or in the tree, so M10/M11, M88/M89, M31/M33 and `G5.1 Q1 R5` cannot be checked by anyone. Please post the manual's document number and edition (and the title as printed), or attach the sample G-code (your own program or the one from @spikeypineapple, with their OK) as a PR comment or under `docs/`. Posted G-code that rests on unverifiable M-codes is the case the Prime Directive is about. Regarding your question on manuals: citing a public manual by number and page is fine; please don't paste its text, and no Fusion/HSMWorks post text.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `doosan_dnm_post` | 7 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `fanuc_post` | 11 passed |
| `machine_library` | 11 passed |
| `machine` | 33 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 24 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts, dependency, process-file or snapshot PNG changes. No CHANGELOG edit.

### Requested before merge
1. `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:125-139`: drop the machine-name sniff for M10/M11 (or document it as an assumption); codes must be declared.
2. Doosan manual: document number, edition and page(s) in `doosan-dnm.cps:11-20` and `docs/decisions/614-doosan-dnm-post.md`, and/or attach the sample G-code showing M10/M11, M88, M31/M33 and `G5.1 Q1 R5`.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `doosan-dnm.cps` is far over 400 lines; post scripts are exempt.
- Body ends `Fixes #614`, has a `Changelog:` line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: cc621e35479a31a2c9f1ea2eab7dd5bebb2c1e11 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Re-review of head cc621e3 (previous review @ 858c613b asked for two things; both are addressed).

**Earlier requests**
1. Name sniffing: gone. `getRotaryCodes` (doosan-dnm.cps:125-149) now reads only post options, properties, or machine fields, and `ensureRotaryUnclamped/Clamped` (:171-196) refuse by name when nothing is declared. `rotaryBrake: true` selects M10/M11 explicitly, and the decision file (item 3) records that. The test `doosan_dnm_refuses_undeclared_codes_by_name` runs on both a generic VMC and the DNM machine.
2. Provenance: the .cps header (:11-27) and docs/decisions/614-doosan-dnm-post.md now give the DN Solutions manual number MV0009OPE241_v0, revision v0 (2024-06-11), with Part/section/page for M10/M11 (p.180), M88/M89 (p.217), Alarm 2323 (p.232) and the optional M31/M33 (marked as an optional package). `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc` backs G5.1 Q1 R5 / Q0 and the G65 probing macros.

**No regressions**: "Doosan DNM" is in `posting::MACHINES` (posting.rs:40) and "Doosan DNM 5700" in the machine library (:180). The A axis is consistent (rotary about X, coordinate 3, in the .mch; A on its own blocks in the post). M31/M33 are never defaulted; they are declared or refused by name. No build.rs, .github, scripts or dependency changes. No snapshot PNG changes.

**Local results** (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| doosan_dnm_post | 7/7 |
| conformance | 6/6 |
| posting | 17/17 |
| fanuc_post | 11/11 |
| machine_library | 11/11 |
| machine | 33/33 |
| golden_cl | 24/24 |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The machine file `assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch` still declares no M10/M11, and nothing in the Rust host appears to expose `machine.rotaryClamp` / `chipConveyorStart` to the script, so the `machine.*` branches look unreachable today. A DNM user must set `rotaryBrake` (or the two codes) in post options. Safe, since it refuses, but the machine file could carry the codes in a follow-up (opening a follow-up issue is optional).
- The evidence sample shows G5.1 and G65 only, not M10/M11, M88/M89 or M31/M33; those rest on the manual citation, which I cannot verify here. Please keep the manual page references accurate.
- docs/decisions/614-doosan-dnm-post.md links the evidence with a local `file:///G:/My%20Drive/...` path; a relative `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc` link would work for everyone.
- Body ends with a Changelog line; I did not check that the body has `Fixes #614` beyond the earlier review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
